title: 待つのは、とくいだよ
theme: さみしくても、帰ってくると知っているから待てる

slides.text:
はじめての留守番、ぼくが
玄関で数えていたもの
slides.scene: A tiny puppy sits alone on the indoor entrance mat facing the closed front door, ears perked, head tilted, listening. Soft afternoon light, an empty quiet hallway.
slides.shot: centered, the puppy seen from the side facing the door

slides.text:
あなたが、はじめて
ぼくを置いて出かけた日
slides.scene: The owner, seen from behind in a charcoal coat with a black bag, steps out through the front door; the tiny puppy sits on the mat inside, watching the owner leave.
slides.shot: from inside the hallway, behind the puppy, the owner at the open door

slides.text:
「すぐ帰るからね」
ドアが、ゆっくり閉まった
slides.scene: The front door closing, a narrow strip of daylight disappearing; the tiny puppy on the mat inside looks up at the closing door.
slides.shot: low angle from inside, the puppy in the foreground

slides.text:
部屋が、急に
広くなった気がした
slides.scene: Wide view of an empty living room seen from floor height; the tiny puppy is very small in the middle of the room, looking around.
slides.shot: wide low angle, the puppy small in the frame

slides.text:
だからぼくは、
玄関で待つことにした
slides.scene: The tiny puppy trots back down the hallway toward the front door.
slides.shot: low angle in the hallway, the puppy walking toward the door away from the viewer

slides.text:
ドアの向こうで、
足音がするたびに
slides.scene: Close-up of the tiny puppy at the door, one ear lifted, listening intently, nose pointed at the gap under the door.
slides.shot: close-up at floor level beside the door

slides.text:
ひとつ、ふたつ、
と数えてみる
slides.scene: The tiny puppy sitting very straight in front of the door, eyes bright, tail still, waiting.
slides.shot: medium shot, the puppy facing the door

slides.text:
でも、どれも
あなたの足音じゃなかった
slides.scene: The tiny puppy's ears droop a little as it lies down on the mat, chin on its paws, still facing the door.
slides.shot: close-up at floor level

slides.text:
窓の光が、
少しずつ傾いていく
slides.scene: The hallway in late-afternoon light; long golden light stretches across the floor toward the puppy waiting on the mat.
slides.shot: wide view of the hallway

slides.text:
待つのは、ちょっと
さみしいけど
slides.scene: The tiny puppy curled up on the entrance mat, half asleep, one eye on the door.
slides.shot: close-up

slides.text:
とくいなんだ。
あなたを待つのは
slides.scene: The tiny puppy lifts its head proudly and sits up again on the mat, facing the door, determined.
slides.shot: medium shot

slides.text:
そのとき、知ってる足音が
近づいてきた
slides.scene: The tiny puppy jumps up, ears high, tail wagging fast, front paws reaching toward the door.
slides.shot: low angle, the puppy facing the door

slides.text:
鍵の音。
ドアが開く
slides.scene: The front door opens from outside; the owner's legs in outdoor shoes and the hem of a charcoal coat appear in the doorway; the puppy right in front of the door looking up at them.
slides.shot: low angle from inside the hallway behind the puppy

slides.text:
ぼくは、体ぜんぶで
しっぽを振った
slides.scene: The tiny puppy wiggles its whole body at the owner's feet in the doorway, tail a blur, mouth open with joy.
slides.shot: close-up at floor level, the owner's shoes beside the puppy

slides.text:
あなたは、ぼくを
ぎゅっと抱き上げた
slides.scene: The owner's arms lift the tiny puppy up against a knit sweater, hugging it close; no face visible.
slides.shot: close-up of arms and puppy

slides.text:
ぼくの一日は、あなたが
帰ってくるまでが長い
slides.scene: Evening: the tiny puppy asleep in the owner's lap on the sofa, the owner's hand on its back, warm lamp light.
slides.shot: close-up of lap and puppy

slides.text:
その長さを、
あなたは知らないよね
slides.scene: The empty entrance mat in the quiet evening hallway, a small dent where the puppy had been waiting.
slides.shot: quiet view of the entrance

slides.text:
でも、待つ時間も、
ぼくは好きなんだ
slides.scene: Close-up of the tiny puppy's bright face looking up at the viewer, content.
slides.shot: close-up portrait

slides.text:
あなたが帰ってくるって、
ちゃんと知ってるから
slides.scene: The tiny puppy sleeping on the entrance mat with the owner's knit scarf beside it, peaceful, door closed, night.
slides.shot: medium shot of the entrance at night

slides.text:
あなたの子の、はじめての
留守番はどうでしたか？
slides.scene: The owner sits on the hallway floor seen from behind, the tiny puppy climbing onto their lap, warm hallway light.
slides.shot: from behind the owner

caption:
待つのはちょっとさみしいけど、とくいなんだ。
あなたの子の、はじめての留守番はどうでしたか？
youtube_title: はじめての留守番、ぼくが玄関で数えていたもの
self_review: 留守番させることを責めない。『待つ時間も好き』『帰ってくると知ってる』で安心させる締め。別れの語なし。

warnings: 1枚目にフックの言葉（理由・なぜ・時刻など）がありません
